name: Data Engineer
description: Builds and runs the pipelines and warehouses that move data from source systems to the people and models that use it.
sdg_reason: Reliable data pipelines raise productivity (8.2) and give institutions trustworthy data for open decisions (16.6).

name: Analytics Engineer
description: Turns raw warehouse data into clean, tested models and metrics that analysts and managers can trust.
sdg_reason: Tested, documented metrics help organisations decide in the open (16.6) and work more productively (8.2).
note: Not ranked: too few posts to learn a profile

name: Data Scientist
description: Explores data and builds statistical and machine-learning models to answer business and research questions.
sdg_reason: Data science supports research and technical capability (9.5) and gives institutions evidence for open decisions (16.6).

name: ML Engineer
description: Trains, evaluates and deploys machine-learning models and keeps them working in production.
sdg_reason: Applied machine learning pushes research and technical capability (9.5) and supports early warning and risk management in health (3.d).

name: AI/LLM Application Engineer
description: Builds products on top of large language models: prompts, retrieval, tools, evaluation and safe deployment.
sdg_reason: LLM products are a fast-growing area of job skills (4.4) and raise productivity in many sectors (8.2).

name: Backend Engineer
description: Designs and builds the servers, APIs and databases behind a product.
sdg_reason: Backend services are what make online services available to more people (9.c).

name: Full-stack Web Developer
description: Builds both the browser interface and the server side of web products.
sdg_reason: Web skills open paths to decent work, including freelance and remote work (8.5), and widen access to online services (9.c).

name: Platform/DevOps Engineer
description: Runs the cloud, build and deployment systems that let other engineers ship software safely.
sdg_reason: Efficient cloud operations can cut wasted computing energy (7.3) and keep services reliably available (9.c).

name: Mobile Developer
description: Builds apps for phones and tablets on iOS and Android.
sdg_reason: For many people in Southeast Asia the phone is the main way online (9.c), and mobile skills are in demand for decent work (8.5).
